property.name: pass_count
property.comment: the number of tests that succeeded.

property.name: fail_count
property.comment: the number of tests that failed.

property.name: timeout_count
property.comment: the number of tests that timeout.

query.name: project-list
query.sql: SELECT project.name AS name, project.status AS status, COALESCE(branch.name, '') AS branch_name, COALESCE(branch.tag, '') AS branch_tag, COALESCE(branch.status, 0) AS branch_status, build.finish_date AS build_date, COALESCE(build.status, 0) AS build_status, COALESCE(build.tag, '') AS build_tag, COALESCE(build.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(build.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count, COALESCE(build.timeout_count, 0) AS timeout_count FROM porion_project AS project LEFT JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON project.id = branch.project_id AND branch.status != 0 LEFT JOIN porion_last_build AS last_build ON last_build.branch_id = branch.id LEFT JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id
query.sql-count: SELECT count(project.id) FROM porion_project AS project

query.name: project-dependency-list
query.comment: Get the list of projects that another project depend on
query.sql: SELECT project.name AS name, project.status AS status, COALESCE(branch.name, '') AS branch_name, COALESCE(branch.tag, '') AS branch_tag, COALESCE(branch.status, 0) AS branch_status, build.finish_date AS build_date, COALESCE(build.status, 0) AS build_status, COALESCE(build.tag, '') AS build_tag, COALESCE(build.pass_count, 0) AS pass_count, COALESCE(build.fail_count, 0) AS fail_count, COALESCE(build.timeout_count, 0) AS timeout_count FROM porion_dependency AS dependency INNER JOIN porion_project AS project ON dependency.project_id = project.id LEFT JOIN porion_branch AS branch ON project.id = branch.project_id AND branch.status != 0 LEFT JOIN porion_last_build AS last_build ON last_build.branch_id = branch.id LEFT JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id WHERE dependency.owner_id = :project_id
query.sql-count: SELECT count(project.id) FROM porion_project AS project
